Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with my grill.  Although the shipping box was damaged, the contents were not. I watched a Utube video which made assembly very strait forward. It has worked very well and produces even heat.  I can control the temperature and have had no trouble cooking a variety of meals on it.
Results.Title: Spirited grilling

Results.ReviewText:
C’est un excellent rapport qualité -prix. Très bonne construction et agréable à utiliser. 
Merci!
Results.Title: Je le recommande fortement

Results.ReviewText: I have purchased several grills over the years! Nothing compares to the Weber quality I’ve found on this grill! You know when you turn down the heat on the cheaper grills and it still burns your food?!?!  Well, you won’t have to worry about that anymore! Great temperature control and no huge flame fare-ups!! Grill grids are heavy duty and had minimal sticking and without using oil!
Results.Title: Best grill I’ve ever cooked on!!

Results.ReviewText: Good quality. I am very happy so far with how it grills.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Just started cooking on the grill. Followed the cooking directions on the laminated card. Steak came out perfectly seared on the outside and with a red center in the inside. Juicy and tender. Same with burgers we grilled. 
The grill is powerful and heats up within a few minutes. The meats cook much faster than other grills. Controls are easy to use. The steel cooking grill is thicker than that of  other grills I have purchased/used before so it should last much longer. All in all this grill was an excellent pujrchase.
Results.Title: Excellent product: You get what you pay for!

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve owned. Hope it lasts longer than the other grills. With a ten year warranty it should.
Results.Title: My new grill.

Results.ReviewText: Good cooking product when fully functioning.... have problem with igniter.  Ordered part and been waiting for over a month for part...in the meantime, using a match... a little embarrassing on a year old $400 one year old product... have Weber charcoal too... really hoping to get problem resolved.
Results.Title: Great product when functioning

Results.ReviewText: We are very pleased with our new Weber grill so far.  Have only had it a short while. This grill replaced a Weber that was purchased in 1991 and it  was the best ever grill.  We know the new one is going to be just as good. There is no end to the wonderful things you an cook and even bake on a Weber.
Results.Title: Replacing a 30 year old Weber with a new one.

Results.ReviewText:
I've only had the grill about a month.  Have used it it several times.  I like how even the heat seems to be over the entire cooking area. I did have to assemble it, and the assembly took me about 2 hours.  It's not complicated, just lots of parts to put together.
I like the LP tank scale to provide a gage for how much fuel is left.  I bought the Weber cover for the grill.  I like the material, but don't like the way the straps work at all.  It gets very windy at times where I live, and I'm not sure if the way the cover straps work, if it will keep the cover on the grill. I had another company's grill that was only 2 years old but the heat distribution on it was terrible.  I paid over twice as much for this grill. I'm counting on it lasting many more years then my previous one.
Results.Title: So Far, So Good

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill, lots more plastic than my last one but Glad weber sells the parts to fix grills instead of throwing them away.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E 310 Gas

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for taking the time to review the Spirit E-310 gas grill. We are happy that you have enjoyed your Weber Q so much! Sorry to hear that you are having trouble with the Spirit grill and keeping the grease under control. There are certain ways to clean the grill to prevent any flare ups from occurring. We do have maintenance tips on our website that would be able to assist with this issue. If you have any questions, please let us know by either calling our support team at 800-446-1071 or emailing us at support@weberstephen.com. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill because I wanted to up-size from my Q series which I’ve used for many years. The Q series will cook the perfect steak every time. The Spirit, on the other hand, has very poor grease and flare-up control. I expected more from Weber.  I gave it 3 stars only because of the build quality.
Results.Title: Poor Performance

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I have ever owned. Well worth the extra few dollars for quality.
Results.Title: Weber gas grill

Results.ReviewText: I am very satisfied with the Weber products. So much so that I now have 2 Weber grills. Refuse to buy any other brand.
Results.Title: Simply the best!

Results.ReviewText: After exchanging grills, the first one the door kept coming off, I’m loving this grill.
Results.Title: Loving It.

Results.ReviewText: The unit is performing well, as expected. I am, however, concerned about a sputtering sound from the rear of the grill burners - where the flames are yellow.
Results.Title: Question about sputtering

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber and after just a few uses I am loving it. The igniter actually works. Hah!  It’s hard to see the flame to check that it lit but you can hear its “poof” start and feel the heat right away. The grates clean up easily and I am going to enjoy the hanging scale to note the tank’s fullness.
Results.Title: My first  Weber - love it

ClientResponses.Response: We are very sorry for the delay on your shipment for your casters. Unfortunately, we have parts on back order due to high demand. We are trying to get orders out as soon as the parts are available. You will receive a tracking email once it has been shipped out. Thank you for your patience.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Wheel fell off my new Weber grill which should never happen. Called your customer service department and ordered a replacement and heard they are on a long backorder!!   That sucks!
Results.Title: Wheel fell off my new Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: J'ai acheté ce bbq pour remplacer un autre qui ne fonctionnait pas bien. Je suis très satisfait de mon achat. Facile à monter, produit de qualité. Fonctionne très bien lors de la cuisson.
Results.Title: Produit de qualité

Results.ReviewText: I have owned 3 Weber grills over the past 25 years.  My first Weber was one of the early Genesis models.  It was amazing and lasted almost 10 years.  The second grill I down-sized to a Spirit 210.  It was also amazing.  Both of these grills were excellent at reducing flare ups.  When I purchased my 3rd grill I thought I was upgrading (larger and newer) to a Spirit E-310.  I immediately noticed the larger gaps between the flavor bars......and unfortunately, this difference seems to result in more flare ups.  My new E-310 has more grilling space, but I get more flare ups.
Results.Title: I prefer my previous Weber Spirit 210

Results.ReviewText: We love the quality, looks and performance of our grill!   We had GREAT service with Carl Affrunti at Noonan's True Value!
Results.Title: our wonderful weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I have had this grill for 1 year. After 1 year I have had to change the back cross burner and the flavorizer bars (burner covers). The bars I understand, but the cross burner I should not have had to replace already. The cross burner was not available to purchase directly from Weber which I really did not like. If it wasn't for that cross burner, I would give this 5 stars
Results.Title: Great grill just needs maintenance after 1 year

Results.ReviewText: Perfect sized for our family of 5, easy to use cooks great
Results.Title: Great size

Results.ReviewText: just purchased, great product, grill is amazing  best grill I've ever had.
Results.Title: E 310

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber Grill, first 3 burner. Cooks great. Getting ready to try some indirect cooking with some larger cuts of meat.
Results.Title: Third times the charm.

Results.ReviewText: Love it! It is sturdy and all part are high quality. You can get replacement parts and callcenter works great.
Results.Title: It will last forever

Results.ReviewText: Love it !! well built great grill!! First Weber I purchased you get what you pay for in this case I guess
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText: It is well built, well designed, and provides even, consistent heat without flareups or hot spots. I’ve been very impressed with both the quality and finish.
Results.Title: Takes grilling to the next level.

Results.ReviewText:
Perfect grill for everyday hamburgers and hotdogs, but will also handle high-temp searing applications like steaks and chops very easily.  Recommend some practice with the burners first before trying something technical like fish.

Wide grill bars hold heat very well.  Preheats quickly and the factory temperature gauge is reasonably accurate.  Recently started doing longer cooks and smokes for pork shoulder and brisket and it holds a low-temp 280-310F range very well, better than an oven, i'd say, and using only 2 of the 3 burners at less than 50%.
Results.Title: Consistent, even cooking, at multiple temperatures

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill. Great price! First Weber grill I have owned!
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: Works great! Grills food so good. So easy to clean.
Results.Title: Kimmy's Spirit!!!

Results.ReviewText: Weber delivers!  So happy with our purchase.  Easy to use, does a great job every time.   Thanks, Weber!
Results.Title: Great Grilling With Weber!!

Results.ReviewText: Very happy with this grill.  Works well.  Good size. Especially like that you can tell how much propane is left in the tank.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I was able to easily assemble my new grill. The instructions were well illustrated and the steps were easy to follow. It took me about 40 minutes including removing the generous packing materials that protected all the various components. I enjoy knowing how much propane is left in the tank by viewing the handy gauge that also secures the tank to the grill. Starting the grill is so easy & the easy to read temperature gauge helps me keep on top of the grilling. I also enjoy using the Weber app to help judge what temperature to use when grilling various meats. I also am very happy with the dials for the burners. I know that when I turn it to the off position it is off. It has a lock position so I know that I’ve got it turned completely off.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit 3 =smooth grilling

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
